annotations.text:
DB CheckOut — Spanish-first crew app, wired to JobTread.
Top: how it connects to the JT Production board & JT Forms.
This row, left to right: job queue → job home → inspection checklist → report a problem (photo + voice ES/EN → English note) → cleanup checklist → send to JobTread.
Customers & addresses are sample data; PM names and statuses come from your JobTread.

Punch crew flow — same app. The PM assigns repairs on the JT Production board; the crew sees where to go, what to do, what to bring, and checks off each repair with before/after photos. The PM verifies and JT status moves to Job Completed.

PM side — English-first, same app (or desktop). Everything the crew sends lands here: review inspection results & problem reports, assign repairs to a crew member with due date and materials, then verify before/after photos. Approvals write to JobTread: task closed, status advanced.
